description: Cross-zone service discovery: which mDNS services and UDP broadcasts are relayed to this module.
_note: update-service.sh execs install-service.sh (reconcile-in-place). Both fields are relay declarations the discovery plane converges as a set.

discoveryMdns.note: mDNS service types relayed across zones so a client in one zone can find this module in another. A relay change is a firewall/avahi reload, not a guest change.

discoveryUdpRelay.note: UDP broadcast ports relayed across zones (discovery protocols that predate mDNS). Same cost.
